definition: the large land seen from an island
description: From a high rocky headland with pink sea flowers, the view looks over a northern bay at golden hour. A long line of brown horses splashes through the calm shallow water towards a sandy beach on the wide green mainland, the first horse reaching the sand at the end. Across the bay lie a pine forest and a small village at the foot of distant mountains, and small boats dot the glowing water under a low sun. A seal rests on the rocks below.
